notes.title: Steam Game Festival
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! We have just released two early demos for Steam Game Festival. Feel free to give them a try! Thank you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294260/Final_Frame/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293510/Anicon__Animal_Complex__Rabbits_Path/

You can also follow our game developer page here: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/zeivainc

Thank you very much!

notes.title: Natural - Beyond Nature - is now available in German
notes.content:
Natural - Beyond Nature - is now available in German!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26751316/7b2581d98f611fb51d6071e6177aa83780a763f5.jpg[/img]

Many thanks to Marcel Weyers for helping me to translate this!

Aside from that, I have also changed the title screen a little, fixed some minor bugs and typos.

We have also released a new game. Feel free to check it out! Thank you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/945590

notes.title: New Zeiva Inc Game: Dragon Essence - Color My World -
notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/603380/Dragon_Essence__Color_My_World/

Hello, everyone! After six years of production, we have finally finished our newest game, Dragon Essence - Color My World -! If you enjoy our games, please give it a try! Thank you!

[h1][b]STORY SUMMARY[/b][/h1]

In a world where humans worship dragons as their gods, a human girl and a dragon boy meet each other by chance.

A feudal fantasy Visual Novel - follow the story of Chi An as she struggles between the responsibility towards her family, society, and freedom to pursue her own happiness.

[h1][b]FEATURES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Romance, Drama & Fantasy
[*]30+ Illustrations & 4 Endings
[*]10 Original Soundtrack
[*]Rated Teen 13+
[/list]
